findings.evidence: lock a Member account after 5 consecutive failed login attempts within a 10-minute window
findings.rationale: Specifies the account lockout trigger and action but omits the lockout duration (timeout) and the unlock/recovery procedure or user notification.

findings.evidence: notify him by email
findings.rationale: The pronoun 'him' has multiple plausible antecedents (the Member, the Guarantor, or the Librarian), leaving the email recipient ambiguous.

findings.evidence: TBD minutes
findings.rationale: Contains an explicit 'TBD' placeholder instead of specifying the token expiration duration in minutes.

findings.evidence: user-friendly; easy to navigate; loads rapidly; standard connections
findings.rationale: Uses subjective, unquantified terms ('user-friendly', 'easy to navigate', 'loads rapidly', 'standard connections') with no measurable acceptance thresholds.

findings.evidence: at most TBD consecutive times
findings.rationale: Contains an explicit 'TBD' placeholder instead of specifying the maximum number of consecutive loan renewals.

findings.evidence: validate item eligibility within 2 seconds and issue the loan receipt
findings.rationale: Describes only the happy path after validating item eligibility and omits the system behavior, error message, or denial handling when an item is ineligible or the barcode scan fails.

findings.evidence: the allowed maximum number of active hold requests
findings.rationale: References a numeric limit ('the allowed maximum number of active hold requests') without specifying the actual maximum count anywhere in the SRS.

findings.evidence: borrow up to 8 physical items simultaneously
findings.rationale: Allows a Member in good standing to borrow up to 8 physical items simultaneously, contradicting SD-009 which caps simultaneous checkouts at 5 physical items.

findings.evidence: set the standard loan period for circulating print books to 21 calendar days
findings.rationale: Sets the standard loan duration for circulating print books to 21 calendar days, contradicting SD-010 which specifies 14 calendar days.

findings.evidence: Unverified visitors shall be able to self-register online with only an email address and immediately check out physical books without Librarian ID verification
findings.rationale: Allows unverified visitors to self-register with only an email address and immediately check out physical books without ID verification, contradicting SD-001 which requires a Librarian to verify government-issued photo ID and record full name, email, and phone number before account creation.

findings.evidence: remain held indefinitely until the requesting Member explicitly cancels the hold
findings.rationale: States that reserved items on the pickup shelf remain held indefinitely until explicitly cancelled by the Member, contradicting SD-011 which automatically cancels uncollected holds after 72 hours and notifies the next Member in queue.

findings.evidence: send an overdue email and/or suspend borrowing privileges and/or apply a penalty flag
findings.rationale: Uses stacked 'and/or' connectives across three actions, making it ambiguous which specific action or combination of actions is mandatory at 7 days overdue.

findings.evidence: shall be reviewed, approved, and recorded with a reason code in the audit log
findings.rationale: Uses passive voice without identifying which human role (e.g., Librarian, Administrator) reviews and approves fine waiver requests or which system component records them in the audit log.

findings.evidence: if appropriate
findings.rationale: Uses the non-binding weak phrase 'if appropriate' (and leaves 'before the due date' unquantified), making it subjective and unverifiable when SMS alerts must be sent.

findings.evidence: TBD years
findings.rationale: Contains an explicit 'TBD' placeholder instead of specifying the archival retention period in years for payment receipts.

findings.evidence: overdue fine of $1.25 USD per overdue day per item with no maximum cap on accumulated fines
findings.rationale: Specifies an overdue fine of $1.25 USD per day with no maximum cap, contradicting SD-019 which sets the rate at $0.50 USD per day capped at $20.00 USD per item.

findings.evidence: permitted to renew borrowed items online at any time regardless of any unpaid overdue fine balance
findings.rationale: Permits Members to renew borrowed items regardless of any unpaid overdue fine balance, directly contradicting SD-020 which blocks borrowing and renewing whenever an unpaid fine balance exceeds $5.00 USD.

findings.evidence: Patron's active loan count; Patron profile screen
findings.rationale: Introduces the term 'Patron' instead of the established role term 'Member' used consistently across earlier requirements (such as SD-001 and SD-009).

findings.evidence: quickly; many users
findings.rationale: Uses unquantified terms ('quickly', 'many users') without specifying a target response-time latency or concurrent user load.

findings.evidence: where possible
findings.rationale: Uses the non-binding qualifier 'where possible', leaving the conditions under which query term highlighting is required or omitted undefined.

findings.evidence: sufficient ISBN matching accuracy; acceptable response times
findings.rationale: Uses subjective, unquantified adjectives ('sufficient', 'acceptable') without defining measurable accuracy or response-time thresholds.

findings.evidence: efficiently; large batch MARC21 files; noticeable system slowdown
findings.rationale: Uses vague, unmeasured terms ('efficiently', 'large', 'noticeable system slowdown') without specifying throughput, file-size limits, or permissible performance degradation.

findings.evidence: shall detect the active references
findings.rationale: Specifies only that the Catalog Service detects active loans or holds on deletion attempt, without defining the resulting system behavior (such as blocking deletion and returning an error).

findings.evidence: TBD intervals
findings.rationale: Contains an explicit 'TBD' placeholder instead of specifying the backup execution schedule/interval.

findings.evidence: important administrative actions; in a timely manner; an appropriate period
findings.rationale: Uses subjective, unquantified terms ('important', 'in a timely manner', 'an appropriate period') without enumerating audited events, logging latency, or retention duration.

findings.evidence: shall log event FAILOVER-01
findings.rationale: When the primary database node is unreachable for over 10 seconds, the Failover Manager only logs FAILOVER-01 without specifying the actual failover, recovery, or alerting behavior.

findings.evidence: adequate transport security; clear error messages
findings.rationale: Uses subjective terms ('adequate', 'clear') without specifying concrete transport security standards (e.g., TLS version) or testable error message criteria.

findings.evidence: accept any Member password of at least 8 characters
findings.rationale: Accepts any password of at least 8 characters, contradicting SD-002 which requires at least 12 characters containing uppercase, lowercase, and numeric characters.

findings.evidence: keep authenticated web portal sessions active for 60 minutes of user inactivity
findings.rationale: Keeps web portal sessions active for 60 minutes of inactivity, contradicting SD-004 which terminates sessions after 15 minutes of inactivity.

findings.evidence: encrypt all Member passwords using reversible AES-256 encryption so Administrators can decrypt and retrieve forgotten passwords upon request
findings.rationale: Requires storing Member passwords with reversible AES-256 encryption decryptable by Administrators, contradicting SD-003 which mandates one-way bcrypt hashing (cost factor 12) and prohibits storing plaintext passwords.
